description: This file defines the EntityWatchServices class which provides a service method 'watchEntity' to monitor changes in entity objects within the OFBiz framework. The method handles detecting changes to specific fields or entire entities and logs corresponding info messages.

classes.name: EntityWatchServices
classes.description: Contains static service method 'watchEntity' for entity change monitoring.

methods.name: watchEntity
methods.description: Monitors changes to an entity or its specific field, logs change events, and returns a success status.
